jeux.name: La salle de jeux · The games room
jeux.alt: The games room of the games house seen from high up at an angle: a black-and-white checkerboard floor, cream walls painted with big black dice-pip dots and tall shelves of board games. At the back left a girl in a green dress kisses a four-leaf clover beside two big white dice on a little table, and Monsieur Verbe stands on a red-and-white ring buoy holding out a fan of cards. At the back right a grandpa sighs over a board game while his grandson cheers with both fists up, and beside them a man dressed as a czar in a fur crown, eyes shut, draws a ticket from a black top hat. In the foreground a grey-haired lady sips lemonade through a long straw over her chessboard, Monsieur Verbe stands by a little potted tree with a finger to his lips and a card at his sleeve, and a farmer in a red bandana shoves a big wooden pawn across the floor. At a round green card table on the right a man with a curly moustache presses down a card with one red heart, facing a lady in turquoise with a golden-star card who toots a party horn. The checkerboard front doors on the left wall lead out to the Boulevard des Loisirs; the narrow purple door in the middle of the back wall leads to the lotto hall, and the red double door on the right to the party room.

doors.label: Le loto
doors.hint: the narrow purple door in the middle of the back wall, to the lotto hall

doors.label: L'anniversaire
doors.hint: the red double door on the back wall at right, to the party room

loto.name: La soirée loto · Lotto night
loto.alt: The lotto hall of the games house seen from high up at an angle: deep purple walls with small gold dots, gold bunting, gilt mirrors and wall lamps, a pale wooden plank floor with a purple rug, stacks of game boxes along the walls, and a low wooden stage with a purple front along the back wall. Up on the stage a lady in a purple dress turns a big wire lottery drum full of coloured balls with a hamster sitting on top, and Monsieur Verbe in his red beret digs into a heap of wooden game tiles with a toy pickaxe. At the back right two moustached men in flat caps shake hands on a bet across a little table with a model Eiffel Tower on it, and a grandma in a pink cardigan dances on tiptoe holding up a bingo card. At the players' table a red-haired lady in a gold dress hugs a sack spilling gold coins as musical notes float up, and on the right a kneeling boy watches a line of black dominoes topple toward a small vase of flowers. In the foreground a girl in a blue tracksuit has just rolled a wooden ball at a row of skittles, one of them a giant wooden key; a beekeeper kneels turning the dial of a small black safe with a big bee on top while her little son cheers; and an old man lies back in a striped deckchair with a green lizard on his knee. The closed purple door with gold dots at the left end of the back wall leads back to the games room.

doors.label: Les jeux
doors.hint: the closed purple door with gold dots at the left end of the back wall, back to the games room

fete.name: La fête d'anniversaire · The birthday party
fete.alt: The party room of the games house seen from high up at an angle: a pink flowered wallpaper wall on the left receding to a mint back wall with a big painted rainbow, white floorboards, balloons, fairy lights, bunting, framed pictures and a sideboard. At the back left a red-haired girl on a stepladder holds up a string of red paper hearts, and beside her a grandma with a white bun stirs a big glass bowl of pink punch with a giant wooden spoon. Three children in ivy crowns dance in a conga line, hands on each other's shoulders. In front, a girl in yellow throws confetti and shakes hands with a little birthday boy wearing a rosette, and a girl in a pink dress on a stool opens a golden envelope with a grey pigeon at her feet. In the middle Monsieur Verbe sits on a hay bale tying a gold ribbon round a present in shiny blue paper. At the long table little Annie blows out five candles on her cake as her uncle reads aloud from a sheet, and on the right a designer in a purple headscarf sets a giant wooden apple core on a white plinth. The red double door in the pink left wall leads back to the games room; the white door with a flower garland in the back wall leads to the wedding hall, and the yellow porthole door at the right end to the carnival courtyard.

noce.name: La noce · The wedding party
noce.alt: The wedding reception hall of the games house seen from high up at an angle: ivory walls with gold trim and golden sconces, swags of white fabric drapes and bunches of white flowers, potted white roses, gold chairs and a honey herringbone parquet dance floor. At the back a lady officiant in a green robe rings a little silver bell at a flower-covered lectern, and a young woman in a pink gown shows off her sparkly engagement ring to her friend in green, who clasps her hands dreamily. Beside a tiered wedding cake, the groom in a grey morning suit waves under a big white flower arch, and an old man in a tweed suit bows deeply before a portrait of a smiling white-haired grandmother on an easel. In the middle a guest dressed as a maharaja in a jewelled turban and gold coat throws red rose petals, beside a nervous young man in a blue suit fanning his face with a paper fan. In front a little girl in a yellow dress leads a small white pony with a big yellow bow tied on its nose, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret and little fairy wings cheers and waves a crescent-moon wand, and a waltzing couple in tails and a pale blue ball gown hold up a big striped beach ball. The white door with a flower garland at the left end of the back wall leads back to the birthday party room.

doors.label: L'anniversaire
doors.hint: the white door with a flower garland at the left end of the back wall, back to the birthday party

carnaval.name: Le carnaval · The carnival
carnaval.alt: The open-air carnival courtyard behind the games house, seen from high up at an angle from the near left: a black-and-white checkerboard wall runs away to the right under a balustraded stone terrace with a flight of steps at the far end, bunting crosses a blue sky, and a striped carnival pole with ribbons stands beside the steps. At the back along the checkerboard wall a lady in an orange dress claps two big clam shells like cymbals, Monsieur Verbe dances a jig on an upturned crate, a tall lady in a red polka-dot dress juggles oranges on a unicycle, and a young man pulls a cart carrying a float shaped like a smiling blue shark. On the cobbles in front, a bald grandpa in a purple cardigan waves with a bunch of balloons, a second Monsieur Verbe makes kitten paws for a giggling toddler on a bench shaped like a giant smiling banana, and a chef heads the parade holding up a platter with a big fish fillet, followed by a man in a padded yellow star costume shaking a maraca, while further back on the right a woman in a pink feathered carnival costume waves from a little red toy car. The yellow door with a round porthole in the checkerboard wall at the near left leads back to the birthday party room.

doors.label: L'anniversaire
doors.hint: the yellow porthole door in the checkerboard wall at the near left, back to the birthday party
